brief: Dock-to-stage median moved from 110 min to 85 min. The bootstrap 95% interval on that drop is 24–26 minutes (Mann–Whitney p < 0.001).
Pick was the recovered bottleneck: 47.5% of baseline dwell, 15.9 minutes faster after zone-pick. Fontana recovered 33.4 minutes at the median; night shift recovered 30.0.
Same-day miss rate fell from 34.2% to 5.5%. That is an operations result, not a model score: cartons either hit the 120-minute dock or they do not.

At the observed mix, the eight-week window returns $22,885 in loaded labor. Payback against a $72,000 slotting/training spend is 4.6 months at this volume. The case is illustrative; a live pilot still needs a held-out control week.
